evidence_observation: The primary study supports exact ephrin-A1-Fc/EphA8 association and receptor-proximal activation in a heterologous fibroblast system, but not purified monovalent affinity or downstream function
limitations: No downstream cellular program, native neural tissue, or traumatic-SCI transfer is established; recombinant-fusion and heterologous-fibroblast boundaries remain explicit.
